summary: Alps Group Inc filed a Form 6-K on June 9, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary MyGenome Sdn. Bhd. received accreditation for Whole Genome Sequencing under MS ISO 15189:2022. This is an operational milestone, not a special situation event. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer; no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural details are present. There is no deal to analyze.
